storyCards.fact:
Flo Rida's "Whistle" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Whistle" is a song by American rapper Flo Rida from his fourth album Wild Ones (2012).

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 29 weeks on the chart.

Whistle was released in 2012.
